description: Lyra in her green tartan collar on a station platform beside a yellow and black train, calm and curious, grey indoor light.
alt: A blue-fawn whippet in a green tartan collar stands on a railway platform next to a yellow train.

description: Lyra bounding towards the camera through deep copper beech leaves under a huge beech tree, peak autumn colour, bright overcast light, joyful.
alt: A whippet runs towards the camera across a carpet of orange beech leaves beneath tall autumn trees.

description: Lyra lying on a grassy riverbank on a lead beside a wide, full river, bare trees on wooded hills behind, early spring, clear blue sky, relaxed.
alt: A whippet in a red collar lies on the grass on a lead beside a wide river under a blue sky.

description: Studio portrait of a fawn and white whippet with a white blaze, sitting on a grey cushion in front of pink rose wallpaper, soft indoor light, alert.
alt: Portrait of a fawn and white whippet sitting on a cushion in front of floral wallpaper.

description: Lyra stretched out on a lead on the grass in front of a ruined stone castle keep, late spring or summer, bright sun and big clouds, contented.
alt: A whippet lies on the grass on a lead in front of the stone tower of a ruined castle.

description: Lyra and a black and white collie-type dog standing together on a sandy path through long dry grass and scrub, late summer or early autumn, warm hazy light.
alt: A whippet and a black and white dog stand side by side on a narrow sandy path through long grass.

description: Lyra walking towards the camera down a wide gravel forest track lined with golden bracken and turning trees, fallen leaves, autumn, soft overcast light.
alt: A whippet walks along a wide gravel woodland track lined with golden bracken and autumn trees.

description: A man seen from behind with a small pale whippet off lead, standing at a junction of tracks in tall conifer woodland, summer greenery, soft light.

description: Lyra lying on a lawn in front of a grand golden-stone country house at sunset, late autumn, warm low light; has a text overlay reading 'Getting to work in beautiful places...'.
